learning_outcomes.text: The aim of the education is to present the role of ERP systems in modern manufacturing enterprises.
Has knowledge of the use of ERP information systems in managing the production of machine parts.
Is able to manage documentation in the process of manufacturing machine parts in a manufacturing enterprise.
Is able to cooperate and work in a group and understands the non-technical aspects of the engineer-mechanic activity, including the impact on the environment

syllabus_topics: Basic functionalities of ERP systems: sales, purchases/orders, production, storage, human resources, document flow, analytics and reporting.
Modularity allowing for the extension of functionality supporting the management of key business areas of manufacturing companies.
Databases, their analysis and the need for continuous expansion of the system along with the changing business environment.
assessment_rules: The condition for passing the course is to achieve all the required learning outcomes specified for the course.
